initiative.title: Data visualization review and example coverage
initiative.summary: Create a transcript-grounded chart review skill, then make chart and feature example coverage explicit, rendered, and checked.

sources.anchor: chart types, defaults, transformations, and auditability
dashboards, controls, filters, and chart defaults
data transformation, source tables, and visible data
shared scales, legends, labels, chart ink, density, and faceting
traceability from data to rendered glyphs
chart, filter, grouping, and repetition semantics
stacking, ordering, treemaps, and positional transforms
table defaults, sorting, filtering, and formatting

claims.statement: Interactive views must be good charts before rich interaction earns credit.
A repository skill must review charts, tables, and dashboards with a consistent rubric.
The rubric must cover titles, hierarchy, spacing, typography, ink, color, axes, ticks, labels, tables, filtering, and multi-view relationships.
The example set must intentionally cover each chart type and material feature.
A rendered feature matrix can make coverage and gaps visible and can support later article content.
Coverage should use a representative basis set instead of every chart-feature combination.
A review should detect when the visible result obscures its data, transformation, scope, or active filter state.

shape.appetite: One small skill, one coverage source, one rendered matrix, one completeness test, and the minimum examples needed to close material gaps.
shape.problem: Current demos prove that chart components render, but they do not prove visual quality or intentional feature coverage.

recommended_shape.skill: One chart-first rubric with chart-family addenda
recommended_shape.verification: One completeness test plus visual reviews

success_moves: Prove the rubric on three contrasting current examples
Separate implemented support from intentional demonstration
Use a representative basis set instead of a Cartesian product
Keep visual judgment in the skill and structural integrity in tests
Improve existing examples before adding new ones

first_proof.question: Does the rubric produce specific and useful findings across simple, faceted, and coordinated views?
first_proof.artifact: Three reviews from the initial repository skill
first_proof.decision_rule: Keep the shape if each review has a clear verdict, blockers, section findings, and three priority fixes.

fast_local_loop.command: pnpm --filter demo test && pnpm --filter demo build
fast_local_loop.fixtures: Existing local datasets and saved demo settings
fast_local_loop.failure_control: Manifest test reports unknown and uncovered feature IDs

milestones.title: The skill gives useful chart-first reviews
milestones.outcome: A repository skill produces decisive reviews for three current examples.
milestones.proof: Review line-chart, categorical-charts, and Lorenz examples.
milestones.valid_intermediate_state: The skill is useful even without the matrix.

milestones.title: Feature coverage becomes explicit and checked
milestones.outcome: A typed manifest and one test expose current coverage gaps.
milestones.proof: All registry types map to examples and uncovered required features remain explicit.
milestones.valid_intermediate_state: The manifest and test work without a rendered matrix.
milestones.rollback: Remove the additive manifest and test imports.

milestones.title: The demo renders the feature matrix
milestones.outcome: A maintainer can inspect and navigate coverage in the demo.
milestones.proof: Desktop browser review plus focused view test.
milestones.rollback: Remove the additive matrix route or view.

milestones.title: A minimal example basis closes material gaps
milestones.outcome: Required features are intentionally demonstrated or explicitly deferred.
milestones.proof: Run the skill on each changed example and mark reviewed only after blockers are cleared.
milestones.valid_intermediate_state: Each revised example improves the current catalog independently.

open_decisions: Keep the first matrix inside the demo
Store only compact review metadata until review history proves useful

history.event: Created intent, shape, and implementation plan from current dictation, repository evidence, and the local transcript set.
